purpose: Independent original holdout frozen before this profile expansion executes. Notes are review-only, never sent to model.

lines.text: I sent Mara five postcards; she sent me none.
lines.semanticCheck: Speaker sent five postcards to Mara; none came back.

lines.text: 雨がやんでも、まだ庭には出ないでください。
lines.semanticCheck: Even if rain stops, do not go into garden yet.

lines.text: 나는 네 사진을 지운 게 아니라 내 사진을 지웠어.
lines.semanticCheck: Speaker deleted own photo, not listener photo.

lines.text: 姐姐没有卖掉钢琴，只把它借给了邻居。
lines.semanticCheck: Older sister did not sell piano; lent it to neighbor.

lines.text: Unless the last bus arrives, we will stay beside the bakery.
lines.semanticCheck: Stay beside bakery unless final bus arrives.

lines.text: 六枚の切符のうち、一枚だけを弟に渡した。
lines.semanticCheck: Of six tickets, handed only one to younger brother; subject omitted.

lines.text: 불이 켜지기 전에는 파란 단추를 누르지 마.
lines.semanticCheck: Do not press blue button before light turns on.

lines.text: 等第三声汽笛响过以后，再把窗帘拉开。
lines.semanticCheck: Open curtains only after third whistle has sounded.

lines.text: The empty station held our silence until sunrise.
lines.semanticCheck: Poetic station holding shared silence until sunrise; no added events.

lines.text: 遠い山の影だけが、眠れない町を静かに包んだ。
lines.semanticCheck: Only distant mountain shadow quietly enveloped sleepless town.

lines.text: 낡은 지붕 아래에서 달빛은 아무 대답도 하지 않았어.
lines.semanticCheck: Under old roof moonlight gave no answer; no invented speaker.

lines.text: 退潮带走了沙上的脚印，却没有带走我们的歌。
lines.semanticCheck: Ebb tide took footprints in sand, not our song.
